description:
## Goal

Establish Study Trade VCP v4's single-owner secure Next.js/NestJS monorepo, Postgres 17, Prisma, Redis/BullMQ, runtime configuration, API contracts and CI foundation.

## Scope

* Modular monolith and worker entrypoint; shared domain types and decimal/time utilities.
* Authenticated responsive web shell; OpenAPI and typed error contract.
* Dev Docker Compose, secrets, migrations, lint/test/build pipelines.

## Acceptance

* A clean checkout boots web, API, worker, PostgreSQL and Redis.
* Login protects private routes; SmartAPI secrets never reach browser or logs.
* Health and integration smoke tests pass in CI.

## Normative source

Study_Trade_VCP_Master_Specification_v4.md §§1,4–5,15–17,21–23. Build only against ST_VCP_4_0; do not invent alternate trading rules.

## Embedded v4.0 requirements (normative, self-contained)

System must be a responsive single-user manual-signal application; never place, modify or cancel brokerage orders. Architecture: Next.js/React/TypeScript/Tailwind/TanStack Query/Lightweight Charts/Socket.IO client; NestJS TypeScript modular-monolith REST/OpenAPI 3.1; BullMQ+Redis worker; PostgreSQL 17 and Prisma. Packages: domain, market-data, indicators, vcp, strategy, portfolio, backtest, database; HTTP API never runs full-universe scans directly. Use HttpOnly SameSite cookies, CSRF protection, per-user authorization and strict DTO validation. JSON wire prices/money are decimal strings; timestamps UTC ISO; local sessions Asia/Kolkata; all financial math NUMERIC(20,6) or precise tick units, integer shares. Store asOf/decidedAt/eligibleFrom separately. Version configuration and evidence. No UI broker credentials. Errors use {error:{code,message,details,requestId},at}, paging {items,nextCursor,asOf,dataRevision}; mutations require Idempotency-Key or If-Match. Run lint/types/tests on CI.

## Module acceptance

Test exact rules including UNKNOWN/fail-closed, chronological availability, database persistence, idempotent retries and at least three boundary cases. Existing Jira requirements above remain applicable.

## Embedded exact requirements — Swing high detection

At candidate completed daily bar i, high is a swing high iff (H\[i\],-i) is lexicographic maximum among indices \[i−3..i+3\]. Ties choose earliest occurrence. A swing at i becomes confirmed only after the close of i+3; the first and last three bars of available history cannot be confirmed pivots. If a bar qualifies as both a high and a low, drop both and flag AMBIGUOUS_DUAL_EXTREMUM; do not invent intrabar ordering. Consecutive confirmed highs without an intervening low collapse to the higher high (tie: earlier), with the original confirmedAt preserved. Store occurredAt and confirmedAt, price in adjusted/current scale, strategy version and data revision. Never allow a historical-as-of scan to see a pivot before confirmedAt.

## Concrete test cases

* Equal swing highs in seven-bar window retain only the earlier high.
* Candidate i at end-of-history with fewer than three right bars emits no confirmed swing.
* A dual high/low candle creates an explicit ambiguity event, not an H→L pair.
* Replay through i+2 does not expose a high confirmed at close i+3.
